verdict.rationale: Foreloop ships a global CLI with a documented, additive `--json` flag on every command and explicitly states it can be run 'from a terminal — and from anything that can run one, including coding agents and cron,' which supports headless/CI automation of projects, tasks, and loops. However, there's no explicit CI pipeline example (e.g., GitHub Actions), and the core agent workflow still centers on a human-run agent in a repo checkout with a required human approval gate, limiting full headless autonomy. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline integration example, evidence of unattended end-to-end runs without human approval, independent/hands-on confirmation of cron/CI usage.
